alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left, shivering a little, facing a digital display on the right that climbs from 64 to 72 degrees. Each time it narrows its eyes and a bubble says brr, a bit more, just a bit or more. At the end it looks down at its feet with wide eyes. In the last seconds the text changes from: me turning up the heat instead of putting on socks, to: dial: 72. socks: in the drawer.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
